scripts.gen: bun install && bun run --cwd packages/schema gen
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd packages/schema typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/lake typecheck && bun run --cwd bench typecheck
scripts.schema-diff: bun run gen && git diff --exit-code -- catalog/schema
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run lint
scripts.render: bun run lake && bun run --cwd bench render
